## Requirements (from spec §12.7/§12.8(d)/§12.6/§12.4 + ticket deliverables)
- R1 Credential gate: present Anthropic key only for a valid per-run proxy credential bound to the run's allowlist
  (endpoints, models, URL policy, cap); strip sandbox Authorization/x-api-key; else 403 `egress.denied`.
- R2 Metering: read every response `usage` (incl. `server_tool_use`, cache read/write), tag run/attempt/agent,
  rate under the run's versioned rate table (Sonnet5 2/10, Opus5 5/25, Fable5 10/50 per MTok; cache read 0.1x,
  cache write 1.25x; web search $10/1k) × 1.4 platform rate; write `usage_records{source:'proxy'}`.
- R3 Cap: Σ metered cost ≥ cap → next request 402 (engine sees `budget`); residual overrun = one in-flight request.
- R4 URL policy + outbound limits: rewrite server-tool bodies (allowed/blocked_domains); web_fetch query >256 chars
  stripped/refused; per-run cap on distinct novel fetched registrable domains; search n-gram diff vs draft
  (≥12-word match → `suspicious_query` pause signal).
- R5 Fetch log of record: every request → `fetch_log` row (run/attempt/agent, url, status, decision); never bodies.
- R6 Key handling: provider key read at start + on SIGHUP (REQ-ARCH-30); BYO-key path stubbed.
- Invariant I1: no sandbox-supplied data alters metering/logging (cost derives from the upstream response only).
- Invariant I2: never silent billing; never an unmetered inference channel.

## Plan (Phase 1)
Build `apps/egress-proxy` as a TypeScript forward proxy. Following the repo pattern (P0.06: pure core + DI
seams + Fakes, deterministic tests; live wiring deferred). Deliberate DESIGN CHOICE from ticket Notes: the
proxy DUPLICATES the credential/URL-policy checks (defense in depth) — it does NOT import @rhema/hooks
`evaluateUrl` or run-task `validateProxyRequest`; it re-implements independently. App depends on no other app.

Files (apps/egress-proxy/src/):
- `rates.ts` — versioned rate tables (Sonnet5/Opus5/Fable5 prices; cache 0.1x/1.25x; web search $10/1k),
  `PLATFORM_RATE = 1.4`, `listCostUsd(usage, table)` and `platformCredits(listCostUsd)`.
- `usage-block.ts` — `extractUsage(body, contentType)` from JSON and SSE Anthropic responses.
- `metering.ts` — `meterResponse()` → a `usage_records{source:'proxy'}` row (precise list cost + credits).
- `context.ts` — RunContext / RunAllowlist / RunContextResolver + the DI interfaces P0.08 fills.
- `credential.ts` — `stripSandboxAuth()`, `validateCredentialedRequest()` (credential + allowlist endpoint/model).
- `url-policy.ts` — proxy-local UrlPolicy + `injectUrlPolicyIntoBody()` (allowed/blocked_domains into server tools).
- `outbound-limits.ts` — `guardWebFetchQuery()` (>256 strip), `longestConsecutiveWordMatch()` n-gram,
  novel-domain tracker; `checkSearchQuery()` / `checkNovelDomain()`.
- `fetch-log.ts` — `buildFetchLogRow()`.
- `cap.ts` — `CapAccountant` (Σ metered credits per run) + in-memory + SQL-backed.
- `sinks.ts` — `SqlExecutor` (structural), SqlUsage/FetchLog writers, `EventSink` (egress.denied + pause signal),
  `SecretProvider` (Anthropic key, start + SIGHUP), in-memory fakes.
- `handler.ts` — `handleProxyRequest()`: the composed pipeline over injected deps (pure of network).
- `server.ts` — node:http server + undici forward (live shell; forward injected, so handler is testable).
- `index.ts` — public exports + `main()` entry.

Ask-first boundaries touched: NONE of the P0.02 schema (I reuse usage_records/fetch_log as-is). The richer
allowlist (models/cap/url-policy) is consumed via a DI `RunContext` P0.08 authors; the DB `proxy_allowlists`
row today has only `hosts` → recorded as a P0.07 deferral for P0.08 to persist the richer shape.

Runtime deps: `@rhema/contracts`, `undici`. Dev deps: `@rhema/db`, `@electric-sql/pglite` (integration test only).

## Test matrix (Phase 1.4 → each AC)
- rates.test.ts: list-cost math per model incl cache read/write + web search; platform-rate credits (R2/AC3).
- usage-block.test.ts: extractUsage from JSON body and SSE (message_start+message_delta) (R2/AC3).
- credential.test.ts: missing credential → 403; wrong credential → 403; off-allowlist host/path → 403;
  off-allowlist model → 403; Authorization + x-api-key stripped before forward (AC1/AC5).
- url-policy.test.ts: blocked_domains/allowed_domains injected into web_search/web_fetch tool bodies (R4).
- outbound-limits.test.ts: web_fetch 300-char query stripped; 12+ consecutive draft-word match → suspicious;
  11-word match → clean; novel-domain cap (R4/AC4).
- cap.test.ts: Σ < cap serves; Σ ≥ cap → 402; the crossing request is served then the next is 402 (AC2).
- metering.test.ts: meterResponse row fields (run/attempt/agent/model/tier/rate_table_version/list_cost/credits).
- fetch-log.test.ts: buildFetchLogRow shape for allow + deny (AC6).
- handler.test.ts (integration, in-process): end-to-end pipeline over fakes + a fake upstream returning fixture
  Anthropic responses — every AC driven through `handleProxyRequest`; asserts 403/402/200, header scrub,
  usage row written, fetch_log row written, suspicious_query signal, egress.denied event.
- db.integration.test.ts (PGlite): apply real migrations, run the SQL writers, read usage_records + fetch_log
  back — proves the rows are valid against the authoritative migration SQL (AC2/AC6, meter-of-record).

Gaps found + closed during the run:
- **Per-turn fetch-log duplication** (self-review): logging allowed server-tool rows from the request body would
  re-log a fetch every turn it stays in history → corrupt "log of record". Closed by sourcing per-fetch/search
  rows from the RESPONSE (once per turn); request-body pass is enforcement/rewrite only. (handler steps 5 + 9)
- **Silent-default meter model**: initial code defaulted to sonnet; changed to the response's authoritative model
  (fallback the validated request model), throw rather than mis-meter (I2). (handler step 8, usage-block extractModel)
- **fetch_log had no `attempt`** (AC6): added additive migration 0006 + Drizzle column (sanctioned extension).
